prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 1 row of equal 9:16 panels, 3 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: CITY ARTERIAL ROAD, Dusk turning to night, blue-indigo sky.
Image 1: the location CITY ARTERIAL ROAD, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back side, with no people
Image 2: the location CITY ARTERIAL ROAD, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front side, with the left side at its right edge, with no people
Image 3: the location CITY ARTERIAL ROAD, the left-side view, facing the left side, with the back side at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location CITY ARTERIAL ROAD, the right-side view, facing the right side, with the back side at its left edge, with no people
Image 5: the location CITY ARTERIAL ROAD, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back side, its bottom edge the front side behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right sides, with no people
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: An empty plate of the wide multi-lane arterial road between glass office towers at dusk, with traffic packing the lanes and the streetlights along the median still off.
Panel 1: Extreme wide shot, high angle, slow pan across the road. Headlights and taillights pack every lane between the glass office towers under a blue dusk sky.
Panel 2: Wide shot, low angle, locked-off camera, along the median. The streetlights along the median flicker on one after another.
Panel 3: Extreme wide shot, eye-level, slow push in toward the towers. The sky darkens to indigo, and office windows light up above the stream of traffic.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
